title: Study Abroad After an Online Degree: Myth or Reality?
description: Can you study abroad after earning an online degree? Uncover the facts, eligibility criteria, and tips to boost your chances of getting accepted overseas.

blocks.x: By Balaji | August 18, 2025
Work-from-Anywhere: How DSU Online Graduates Build Remote Careers

The idea of studying abroad holds an undeniable charm—world-class universities, global exposure, career-defining experiences, and the promise of a better future. But for students enrolled in online degree courses , one major question arises:
Can I study abroad after completing an online degree? Will foreign universities accept it?

The short answer is: yes, you absolutely can. But there are a few important conditions to understand before you start planning. This blog breaks down everything you need to know about pursuing higher studies abroad after an online degree program, especially if you are a student at DSU Online.
Why the World Is Now Open to Online Degrees

A decade ago, online education wasn’t taken very seriously by top institutions around the world. But today, things have changed. Thanks to major digital shifts post-2020, online education is widely recognized as a valid and legitimate mode of learning—especially when the degree comes from a UGC entitled online degree provider.

Universities abroad are increasingly looking at what you learned, how rigorous your program was, and how prepared you are for postgraduate studies. If your degree is from a reputed university with a proper academic structure, it can be accepted just like a traditional degree.
What Makes an Online Degree Eligible for Study Abroad?
If you are aiming for a master’s, diploma, or postgraduate certificate abroad, foreign universities typically evaluate the following:
Recognition:
Your online degree must be from a UGC entitled online degree provider, like DSU Online to ensure academic legitimacy.
Course structure:
The program should match international standards in terms of credits, learning hours, and curriculum depth.
Grades & performance:
A strong GPA or percentage is essential to meet academic thresholds and stand out among applicants.
Proof of skills:
Most universities require proof of English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL), along with internships, research, or relevant projects.
Authenticity:
You must submit verified transcripts, recommendation letters, and a well-written Statement of Purpose to validate your application.
These academic and documentation factors matter more than whether the degree was earned online or on campus.
Top Study Abroad Destinations That Accept Online Degrees
Let us explore how different countries view online bachelor degrees :
United States

Universities in the U.S. consider UGC approved online education valid, especially if the degree matches their credit expectations. A strong SOP, relevant skills, and good GRE/GMAT scores can help boost your profile.
United Kingdom
UK institutions typically accept online degree programs from India if they are government-recognized. DSU Online students, for instance, meet this criterion easily.
Canada
Canadian universities accept online degrees from recognized institutions for PG diplomas and master’s courses. You may also be eligible for post-study work permits.
Australia & New Zealand
These countries acknowledge online education as long as it is officially accredited. Some programs may require extra evaluation of your course syllabus.
Germany
You may be asked to submit your degree for recognition through platforms like uni-assist or anabin. If your online bachelor degree is UGC-approved, it’s usually considered valid.
Online Degree vs Distance Learning: Know the Difference
Don’t confuse online degree courses with distance or correspondence learning. They’re not the same.

FAQs
01. Will foreign universities know that my degree was online?

Yes, it is often mentioned in transcripts. However, what matters more is whether your online degree course is from a recognized, accredited institution. If it is UGC entitled like DSU Online, it’s acceptable.
02. Can I get a student visa with an online degree?
Absolutely, if your degree is valid and you meet the admission criteria, your online education won’t stop you from getting a student visa.
03. What if a university doesn’t accept online degrees?

Some traditional universities might have strict preferences. In that case, consider applying to institutions known for being inclusive of digital learning, or strengthen your case with certifications and work experience.
04. Will I be eligible for scholarships after an online degree?
Yes! Many scholarships are based on merit, need, or specialization, not the learning mode. Focus on building a strong overall profile.
05. Does DSU Online help with study abroad or placements

While DSU doesn’t directly offer foreign admissions, students can benefit from its career readiness support, industry focused curriculum, and internship opportunities, essential stepping stones for global education.
